description.ar: صمم نظام matching وتتبع لمسارح الرحلات
description.en: Design a matching and tracking system for ride-sharing

problemStatement.ar: صمم نظام ride-sharing: راكب يطلب، النظام يطابق سواق قريب، ويتتبع الرحلة لحد ما تخلص. ركّز على location streaming، geo indexing، وmatching تحت الذروة.
problemStatement.en: Design a ride-sharing system: a rider requests, the system matches a nearby driver, and tracks the trip to completion. Focus on location streaming, geo indexing, and matching under peak load.

prompt.ar: قبل التصميم: اسأل عن الـ scope واعمل حسبة.
prompt.en: Before designing: clarify scope and estimate.

text.ar: سألت عن المدن، الـ peak trips، وSLA المطابقة
text.en: Asked about cities, peak trips, and match SLA

ar.how: اسأل: ETA accuracy؟ pooled rides؟
ar.mistakes: خطأ: نظام عالمي واحد من غير city cells.

en.how: Ask: ETA accuracy? pooled rides?
en.mistakes: Mistake: one global system without city cells.

text.ar: قدّرت location updates/sec من السواقين النشطين
text.en: Estimated location updates/sec from active drivers

ar.how: Active drivers × updates/sec.
ar.tradeoffs: أحدث من اللازم = تكلفة؛ أقدم = ETA وحش.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: 10Hz ثابت لكل السواقين.

en.why: This is most of the ingest load.
en.how: Active drivers × updates/sec.
en.tradeoffs: Too frequent = cost; too old = bad ETA.
en.mistakes: Mistake: fixed 10Hz for every driver.

text.en: Clarified match timeout and retry policy

ar.how: مثلاً 15s timeout ثم broaden radius.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: انتظار لا نهائي لمطابقة مثالية.

en.how: E.g. 15s timeout then broaden radius.
en.mistakes: Mistake: waiting forever for a perfect match.

text.en: Asked about payments/safety as system boundaries

ar.how: Trip state آلة حالات. الدفع خدمة منفصلة.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تحاول تصمم الدفع والخرائط من الصفر كله.

en.how: Trip state machine. Payments as separate service.
en.mistakes: Mistake: redesigning payments and maps from scratch entirely.

prompt.ar: اوصف rider/driver apps، matching engine، location stream، والـ trip state.
prompt.en: Describe rider/driver apps, matching engine, location stream, and trip state.

text.ar: 📊 Client ↔ WS/LB → API/Router → Matching + Presence/Location → Queue/Workers
text.en: 📊 Client ↔ WS/LB → API/Router → Matching + Presence/Location → Queue/Workers

ar.how: Drivers يبعتوا موقع. Matching يلاقي أقرب مناسب. Trip service يدير الحالة.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: REST polling لكل ثانية من ملايين الأجهزة.

en.why: Realtime + matching is the core path.
en.how: Drivers send location. Matching finds nearest fit. Trip service manages state.
en.tradeoffs: Polling is heavier than WS for locations.
en.mistakes: Mistake: REST polling every second from millions of devices.

text.ar: Geo index: geohash / S2 cells للسواقين المتاحين
text.en: Geo index: geohash / S2 cells for available drivers

ar.how: خزّن driver في cell + neighboring cells search.
ar.tradeoffs: Cell كبيرة = نتايج أكتر. صغيرة = misses.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: Haversine على كل السواقين في المدينة.

en.how: Store driver in cell + search neighbors.
en.tradeoffs: Large cell = more results. Small = misses.
en.mistakes: Mistake: Haversine over every driver in the city.

text.ar: Matching engine: filter + rank (ETA, rating, fairness)
text.en: Matching engine: filter + rank (ETA, rating, fairness)

ar.why: أقرب مسافة مش دايمًا أفضل match.
ar.how: Candidate set من الـ geo → rank → offer → accept.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: assign من غير accept من السواق.

en.why: Nearest distance is not always the best match.
en.how: Candidate set from geo → rank → offer → accept.
en.mistakes: Mistake: assigning without driver accept.

text.ar: Trip state machine في DB قوية + pubsub للتحديثات
text.en: Trip state machine in durable DB + pubsub for updates

ar.why: الحالة لازم تكون صحيحة بعد انقطاع الشبكة.
ar.how: States: requested→matched→enroute→ongoing→completed.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: الحالة في memory الـ matcher بس.

en.why: State must be correct after network drops.
en.how: States: requested→matched→enroute→ongoing→completed.
en.mistakes: Mistake: state only in matcher memory.

prompt.ar: إزاي تـ scale matching وgeo indexes وقت الذروة؟
prompt.en: How do you scale matching and geo indexes at peak?

text.en: Shard by city/geocell; local matching

ar.how: City service cells. Cross-cell edge cases نادرة.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: matching عالمي لكل الطلبات.

en.how: City service cells. Rare cross-cell edge cases.
en.mistakes: Mistake: global matching for all requests.

text.ar: Location stream: Kafka partitions by geohash
text.en: Location stream: Kafka partitions by geohash

ar.how: Partition key = cell. Downstream presence update.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: partition بكل driver id عشوائي يبعثر locality.

en.how: Partition key = cell. Downstream presence update.
en.mistakes: Mistake: random per-driver partitions breaking locality.

text.ar: Autoscale matchers على queue depth / match latency
text.en: Autoscale matchers on queue depth / match latency

ar.how: HPA + surge mode simplifications.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: scale على CPU بس وتنسى match wait time.

en.how: HPA + surge mode simplifications.
en.mistakes: Mistake: scaling on CPU only and ignoring match wait time.

prompt.ar: SLIs: match time، ETA error، location freshness.
prompt.en: SLIs: match time, ETA error, location freshness.

text.en: SLOs: match p95 < 15s, location freshness < 5s

ar.how: Per-city dashboards.
ar.tradeoffs: City outliers تتخفى في المتوسط العالمي.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: metric عالمي واحد.

en.why: This is the core product experience.
en.how: Per-city dashboards.
en.tradeoffs: City outliers hide in a global average.
en.mistakes: Mistake: one global metric.

text.en: ETA error tracking

ar.how: Predicted vs actual arrive.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: مفيش feedback loop على ETA.

en.how: Predicted vs actual arrive.
en.mistakes: Mistake: no ETA feedback loop.

text.ar: Cancel rates بعد match وdriver reject rates
text.en: Post-match cancel rates and driver reject rates

ar.how: Alert على spike في rejects.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تهتم بـ match speed بس.

en.how: Alert on reject spikes.
en.mistakes: Mistake: caring about match speed only.

prompt.ar: Matching storms، GPS spoofing، region partition.
prompt.en: Matching storms, GPS spoofing, region partition.

text.en: Downtown geohash hotspot

ar.how: Subdivide cells، replicate matchers، shed load.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: cell ثابت لكل المدينة.

en.how: Subdivide cells, replicate matchers, shed load.
en.mistakes: Mistake: one fixed cell size for the whole city.

text.en: Thundering herd after rain/concert

ar.how: Surge، queue riders، broaden supply incentives.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تقبل كل الطلبات من غير supply.

en.how: Surge, queue riders, broaden supply incentives.
en.mistakes: Mistake: accepting all requests with no supply.

text.en: Stale driver locations → bad matches

ar.how: Freshness TTL؛ استبعد stale؛ predict path.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تثق بآخر موقع من دقايق.

en.how: Freshness TTL; exclude stale; predict path.
en.mistakes: Mistake: trusting a location from minutes ago.

prompt.ar: Push match vs pull؛ geohash vs quadtree.
prompt.en: Push match vs pull; geohash vs quadtree.

text.en: Push offer to driver vs auto-assign

ar.how: Offers أحسن للـ marketplace؛ auto أسرع.
ar.examples: Many markets use offer with short timeout.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: auto-assign من غير اعتبار تفضيلات السواق.

en.how: Offers better for marketplace; auto faster.
en.examples: Many markets use offer with short timeout.
en.mistakes: Mistake: auto-assign ignoring driver preferences.

text.en: Geohash vs quadtree/S2

ar.how: Geohash سريع للبداية؛ S2 أدق عند القطبين/الحواف.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تتعمق في S2 من غير ما تحل matching basics.

en.how: Geohash is fast to start; S2 is better at poles/edges.
en.mistakes: Mistake: deep-diving S2 without solving matching basics.

text.ar: Strong consistency على trip vs eventual location
text.en: Strong consistency on trip vs eventual location

ar.how: Trip strong. Location eventual OK.
ar.tradeoffs: Strong على الموقع يقتل الـ scale.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: نفس DB consistency لكل شيء.

en.how: Trip strong. Location eventual OK.
en.mistakes: Mistake: same DB consistency for everything.

text.en: Surge pricing signals

ar.how: Demand/supply per cell → multiplier. Clear client UX.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: surge عالمي على مدينة كاملة بنفس الرقم.

en.how: Demand/supply per cell → multiplier. Clear client UX.
en.mistakes: Mistake: one surge number for an entire city.

text.en: Pooled rides matching

ar.how: Separate pool matcher؛ constraints على detour.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تلزق pool في نفس matcher البسيط.

en.how: Separate pool matcher; detour constraints.
en.mistakes: Mistake: bolting pool onto the simple matcher.

text.en: Idle driver repositioning hints

ar.how: Heatmaps للسواقين. مش أوامر إجبارية.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تجبر السواق يتحرك بطرق غير آمنة.

en.how: Driver heatmaps. Not forced commands.
en.mistakes: Mistake: forcing drivers into unsafe moves.

prompt.en: Cost of location stream and matching workers.

text.en: Location ingest dominates cost

ar.how: Adaptive frequency + compression + sampling idle.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: JSON ضخم لكل ping.

en.how: Adaptive frequency + compression + sampling idle.
en.mistakes: Mistake: huge JSON on every ping.

text.ar: Matching compute يتناسب مع demand² محليًا لو brute
text.en: Matching compute scales ~demand² locally if brute

ar.how: Limit K nearest. Early exit.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: O(n) على كل سواقين المدينة لكل طلب.

en.how: Limit K nearest. Early exit.
en.mistakes: Mistake: O(n) over all city drivers per request.

text.ar: Separate idle analytics cluster عن hot path
text.en: Separate idle analytics cluster from hot path

ar.how: Stream to analytics؛ لا تعرقل dispatch.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تجمع analytics جوّا matcher.

en.how: Stream to analytics; do not stall dispatch.
en.mistakes: Mistake: aggregating analytics inside the matcher.

text.en: Location anti-spoofing

ar.how: Sensors heuristics، OS attestation، anomaly detection.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تثق بإحداثيات العميل عمياء.

en.how: Sensor heuristics, OS attestation, anomaly detection.
en.mistakes: Mistake: blindly trusting client coordinates.

text.en: Protect location PII and trip traces

ar.how: Encryption، retention قصيرة للـ raw traces، access control.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: raw GPS مفتوح لكل الموظفين.

en.how: Encryption, short retention for raw traces, access control.
en.mistakes: Mistake: raw GPS open to all employees.

text.en: Safety features: share trip, emergency

ar.how: Secure share links، rate limits، audit.
ar.tradeoffs: يزيد سطح الهجوم لو الروابط ضعيفة.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: روابط مشاركة أبدية من غير authz.

en.how: Secure share links, rate limits, audit.
en.tradeoffs: Increases attack surface if links are weak.
en.mistakes: Mistake: eternal share links without authz.

text.en: City-level blast radius: isolate failure

ar.why: سقوط مدينة مش لازم يسقط كل المدن.
ar.how: Independent cell deployments.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: control plane واحد يوقف كل المدن.

en.why: One city failing should not take down all cities.
en.how: Independent cell deployments.
en.mistakes: Mistake: one control plane stopping all cities.

text.ar: Degraded mode: queued matching / manual dispatch tools
text.en: Degraded mode: queued matching / manual dispatch tools

ar.how: Serve ETAs conservative. Pause non-critical features.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: مفيش وضع degrade موثّق.

en.how: Serve conservative ETAs. Pause non-critical features.
en.mistakes: Mistake: no documented degrade mode.

text.ar: Backups للـ trip ledger وreplay للمواقع الحديثة
text.en: Backups for trip ledger and replay of recent locations

ar.how: RPO صارم على trips؛ locations نافذة قصيرة.
ar.mistakes: خطأ: تعامل location stream زي ledger.

en.why: Trips/money matter more than every ping.
en.how: Strict RPO on trips; short window on locations.
en.mistakes: Mistake: treating location stream like a ledger.

rangeHint.ar: Worker المطابقة غالبًا عشرات/ث حسب الـ ranking.
rangeHint.en: A match worker often does tens/s depending on ranking.

steps.ar: 3) Match workers من peak trip QPS ÷ per-worker capacity.
steps.en: 3) Match workers from peak trip QPS ÷ per-worker capacity.

description.ar: الطلبات ×5 في 10 دقايق. الـ match latency طالع فوق الدقيقة.
description.en: Requests ×5 in 10 minutes. Match latency above a minute.

description.ar: Kafka lag على تحديثات الموقع. الـ geo index قديم.
description.en: Kafka lag on location updates. Geo index is stale.

expectedNote.ar: Offer شائع لأنه يحترم السواق ويقلل cancels.
expectedNote.en: Offer is common because it respects drivers and reduces cancels.
Both are acceptable; explain neighbor search.

whenOtherWins.ar: S2 لو عندك خبرة وخرائط دقيقة عالميًا.
whenOtherWins.en: S2 if you have expertise and need precise global maps.

caption.ar: الراكب يستلم موقع السواق أثناء الرحلة
caption.en: Rider receives driver location during trip
